questions.q: What is Winston Smith's job in the book?
a: Falsifying historic records for the Party
Spying on neighbors for the police
questions.why: The summary says he works in the record department, rewriting history.

questions.q: What is Newspeak designed to do?
a: Eliminate rebellious thinking by shrinking language
Translate the Party's laws for citizens
questions.why: Lesson 1 describes Newspeak as a language that cuts out rebellious thought.

questions.q: What does lesson 2 say freedom means?
a: Saying what's true and making your own decisions
questions.why: Lesson 2 defines freedom as saying what you believe and choosing for yourself.

questions.q: What do telescreens do in the novel?
a: Record and broadcast at the same time in every home
Track people in public squares only
questions.why: The summary describes them as mass-surveillance monitors recording and broadcasting.

questions.q: How does a totalitarian state win, according to lesson 3?
a: By gaslighting citizens out of their individuality
questions.why: Lesson 3 says gaslighting makes people give up individuality.
